name: StateGraph
summary: StateGraph defines runs as plans or applies, supports GitHub and GitLab, and offers multi-state transactions in its Infrastructure as a Database plan. Orchestration Pro costs $12,000 a year, or $1,000 a month on annual billing, and Infrastructure as a Database starts at $25,000 a year.

facts.text: The pricing page defines a run as either a plan or an apply.
Infrastructure as a Database includes multi-state transactions and SQL across all states, according to the pricing page.
The Open Source edition is free under MPL-2.0 and is limited to 3 active users per month for each GitHub or GitLab installation.
The pricing page does not describe how plans or applies are triggered from pull requests.

plans.name: Free
plans.unit: per account, 3 users and 50 runs per calendar month
plans.notes: No credit card needed. One concurrent worker.

plans.name: Orchestration Pro
plans.unit: per month when billed annually, or $12,000 a year
plans.notes: 30-day trial with no credit card. Contact sales for self-hosted.

plans.name: Infrastructure as a Database
plans.unit: per year, starting price on an annual contract
plans.notes: 30-day trial with no credit card. Contact sales for self-hosted.

plans.name: Open Source
plans.unit: self-hosted, 3 active users per month per installation

hiddenCosts: The pricing page uses dollar signs without naming a currency code.
Self-hosted Orchestration Pro and Infrastructure as a Database are contact-sales only.
